stage: Stage 2 -- table 4 with the new CFGen delivery
route_explanation: the six-arm run did NOT meet the gate (MDLM shifted -- see 212_tstr11_reproduction.json), so per the ticket no table is produced from that run. The table instead follows prereg section 5 / ticket 209 amendment 1: CFGen from a single-arm run, the other five rows taken from 211_tstr11.json VERBATIM and not recomputed.
rng_note: in the single-arm run CFGen receives the first arm's rng stream rather than the fourth's, so it draws different cells from the same fixed delivered arrays; every arm draws its own cells anyway
sd_convention: ddof=1 over the five evaluation seeds

classifier_def.model: LogisticRegression(penalty='l2', C=1.0, solver='lbfgs', max_iter=2000, class_weight='balanced', random_state=20260833, n_jobs=1)

selfcheck_3class.stage: Stage 2 -- 3-class self-check of the new script
selfcheck_3class.criterion: every number within 1e-09 of e33_deployed_arm.json block_a (prereg section 6)
selfcheck_3class.what_this_proves: the classifier, the preprocessing and the sampling logic in analysis/e33_tstr11.py are the ones the published table used; the only variable left for Stage 3 is the number of classes
selfcheck_3class.n_jobs_note: the only edit to fit_score was n_jobs=-1 -> n_jobs=1; the numbers above are the empirical check that it changes nothing on the lbfgs multinomial path
